chunks: There are a large number of traditions on this topic, but we have quoted only some of them in order to keep the discussion brief.
ai.seo_question: How does the author handle the volume of available traditions in this chapter?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi employs this rhetorical device to signal the exhaustive nature of the *khabar* corpus regarding Imam al-Mahdi's uprising, a hallmark of his methodical compilation in *Kitab al-Ghayba*. By noting that the reports are too numerous to list, he underscores the widespread consensus (*tawatur*) among early Shia scholars regarding the authenticity and centrality of this eschatological event.
